During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] '''conquered''' the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] during their advance on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The invaders used Malastare as an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] rendezvous point for their [[Warship/Legends|warships]], sparing the planet's infrastructure<ref name="TEA" /> with the exception of the local industrial base.<ref name="EssGuiAlSpec">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>
